t: This is the Wharrie Cabmans Shelter, a small building in Camden. It was designed by Elisabeth Scott, and that matters. Scott was a British architect, born in 1898, who also designed the Shakespeare Memorial Theatre at Stratford-upon-Avon. That theatre was the first important public building in Britain designed by a woman. So this modest shelter comes from the same hand as a landmark in the history of women in architecture.
